Job Summary:

We are looking for a rockstar Emerging SDR to join an unmatched team! As a member of the Drata SDR team, you will be a critical component to an innovative fast-paced Sales Team. You will drive strategic outbound prospecting campaigns (email, phone calls, & social media) to identify potential customers that would benefit from Drata’s solution. You will often be the first point of contact with potential customers with the objective to set qualified meetings for a team of Emerging Account Executives. This is an exciting opportunity for SDR's to be a part of an inclusive team, and experience tremendous career growth.

This is a hybrid role located in New York City.

What you'll do:

  • Strategically partner with emerging account executives to break into prospective customer accounts to generate high quality outbound qualified opportunities

  • Research commercial accounts, identify key initiatives & key players to generate interest through cold discovery calls, email campaigns, and social selling

  • Methodically qualify, build, and manage an accurate sales pipeline; maintain a high volume of activity including outbound cold calls, emails, & social selling - utilizing tools such as Outreach & Nooks

  • Discovering new leads through internet research and social media monitoring/messaging, using tools such as LinkedIn Navigator and ZoomInfo.

  • Utilize your active listening skills to understand and uncover customer needs and business problems to effectively communicate how Drata can solve them

  • Achieving, and exceeding, weekly/monthly metrics (meetings, qualified opportunities, new contacts, etc.)

  • Responsible for accurately tracking customer interactions and information in our CRM, Salesforce

  • Conduct high-level conversations with C-Suite executives in prospect accounts

  • Thrive on change while remaining highly organized, optimistic, and coachable

What you'll bring:

  • A Proven Track Record: 6 months - 2 years of experience in a sales development associate or inside sales role; sales experience in the SaaS space is a plus. We are looking for candidates who thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial business environment and who have a proven track record of success in their past roles and experiences.

  • Intensely Curious: You thrive on learning new concepts, technologies, personas, and can rapidly absorb and integrate that material into your day to day role

  • A Doer: You are driven, self-motivated and a self-starter who brings your ideas to life and takes pride in results. You are resourceful and find ways to get things done regardless of the obstacles. You are not fearful of failure and realize that failure is often a step closer to figuring out what works. Taking on complex challenges excites you, even if you need to ask for help or spend some time figuring out where to begin.

  • Organized: You are detail-oriented and can juggle having a variety of different projects on your plate at one time because you are good at keeping track of them. You can create structure for yourself to be the most successful.

  • A Talented Communicator: You are a “people person” who enjoys communicating with people and has a strong awareness of those around you. You are thoughtful about the ways you communicate and the impression that may have on a client.

  • Mission-Driven: You want to use your talents to make the world a better place and you are in a rush to do it.

  • Confident but Self-Critical: You are confident in your skills and the quality of your work product. At the same time, you are not afraid to ask for help and want to constantly be improving. You value honest, action-oriented feedback and believe that we can use it as a tool to improve as a team.

How we support you:
At Drata, our people are our strongest advantage—and we prove it with support that exceeds industry standards. Our total rewards package is designed to power your well-being, accelerate your growth, and keep your work-life balance thriving.

Explore how we invest in your Life at Drata.

  • Shared Success: We provide stock equity to ensure that as the company grows, you share directly in that success. Equity gives every employee a sense of ownership and the opportunity to celebrate our wins together—because your contributions don’t just support our progress; they help drive our collective success.

  • Health & Wellness: Up to 100% employer-paid premiums for medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their dependents, along with comprehensive wellness benefits and healthcare concierge services designed to support your needs beyond traditional insurance.

  • Financial Well-being: A comprehensive suite of financial benefits, including a 401(k) plan, company-paid life and disability insurance, tax-advantaged spending accounts, and a range of discounted voluntary offerings to help you customize and strengthen your overall financial position.

  • Family Support: We want to support you in life's most important moments, so we offer a paid Parental Leave policy, after six months of employment. Employees also receive access to Kindbody fertility and family-building benefits and dedicated leave specialists who help guide you through the entire process.

  • Growth & Development: Generous annual stipends for both professional and personal development, empowering you to invest in your continued growth. You’ll also have access to a wide range of internal learning opportunities, ensuring you can build new skills, deepen your expertise, and advance your career with confidence.

  • Time Off & Flexibility: We believe that to do your best work, you should get the time you need for rest, rejuvenation and recovery. Drata offers a flexible vacation policy, paid holidays, and other perks to recharge.

The expected OTE range for this role is between $75,000 - $80,000 and is listed to provide transparency. Actual base pay will vary based on multiple factors — market location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and overall alignment to the role.

A top-notch senior product manager will have worked on numerous projects and have a firm grasp of how to satisfy consumers’ needs. Ideal candidates will be equally analytical and creative, and able to justify decisions to a range of stakeholders. This is an ideal position for someone who thrives in changing environments and can build the roadmap to create innovative product offerings.

  • Partner closely with engineering and design teams to define, build, and maintain products/features which are critical to growth and retention

  • Partner closely with cross-functional teams on release plans and documentation to deliver value to our customers

  • Proactively partner across teams to anticipate and address risks and dependencies

  • Communicate progress and plan to leadership, peers, etc.

  • Deep customer empathy

  • Passion for identifying and solving problems with the ability to conduct effective customer interviews

  • Capable of breaking down a big vision into small deliverables

  • Ruthless prioritization of the backlog

  • Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset and the drive to pursue opportunities beyond current constraints

  • Exceptional collaboration skills working with PMs, engineers, designers, marketers, and customer success teams

  • Growth mindset with a desire for continuous improvement

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills

  • Strong analytical skills paired with a data-informed mindset

  • Experience launching a new product offering from 0-1 strongly preferred

  • Experience building complex products for Enterprise customers strongly preferred

  • Experience in the Procurement, Vendors, Third-Party Risk or Risk space strongly preferred

Job Summary:

The Staff Software Engineer, Monetization Platform serves as a technical leader with a primary focus on the systems that turn product usage, subscriptions, credits, commitments, and contracts into accurate customer outcomes and clean financial operations.

This person will architect and evolve the core billing domain for Drata: usage event ingestion, billable metrics, pricing and packaging, invoice generation, entitlement enforcement, and the integrations that connect engineering to Accounting, Finance, RevOps, Salesforce, CPQ, and ERP systems like NetSuite.

They should be equally comfortable designing event-driven systems, shaping commercial flexibility with business stakeholders, and building operationally trustworthy software where correctness, audit-ability, and scale matter. Modern billing is no longer just “charge a credit card once a month” — it is a real-time product control plane that must support evolving pricing models without turning the codebase into a fragile mess.

What you’ll do:

  • Partner with Product, Finance, Accounting, RevOps, and Engineering leadership to shape Drata’s long-term billing architecture and commercial flexibility across self-serve and enterprise motions.

  • Design the primitives of a modern billing platform: usage events, billable metrics, products, rate cards, contracts, credits, subscriptions, overages, and invoice workflows.

  • Architect a system that can accurately meter product usage at scale, transform raw events into billable quantities, and support pricing changes without requiring constant product rework.

  • Build and evolve the entitlement layer that separates pricing and packaging from product behavior, so feature access, limits, credits, and plan controls are programmable rather than hardcoded.

  • Work closely with SFDC admins, CPQ owners, and Finance systems stakeholders to ensure quote-to-cash flows are coherent across CRM, product, billing, ERP, and downstream reporting systems.

  • Ensure billing systems are operationally trustworthy: idempotent event handling, strong reconciliation paths, reliable notifications, auditability, and clear observability for engineers and business teams.

  • Review architecture and code for billing-related projects to ensure correctness, scale, security, and maintainability while empowering teams to own implementation details.

  • Troubleshoot the hard problems: invoice discrepancies, usage drift, contract edge cases, entitlement bugs, migration failures, and cross-system data mismatches.

  • Lead cross-team initiatives such as introducing a usage-based billing foundation, rationalizing packaging models, improving billing developer experience, or migrating from brittle homegrown logic to more composable billing and entitlement systems.

  • Mentor engineers across teams on domain modeling, distributed systems tradeoffs, financial correctness, and the realities of building software where product behavior and revenue recognition are tightly coupled.

What you’ll bring:

  • 10+ years of experience as a software engineer, including meaningful time owning business-critical backend systems in production.

  • Deep experience architecting billing, payments, pricing, or quote-to-cash systems for a B2B SaaS company at meaningful scale.

  • Strong experience designing APIs and event-driven systems that ingest, validate, aggregate, and reconcile high-volume operational data.

  • Strong understanding of modern billing models, including usage-based pricing, subscriptions, prepaid credits, commitments, overages, hybrid packaging, and enterprise-specific commercial terms.

  • Experience working directly with Accounting, Finance, RevOps, and GTM systems where data quality, auditability, and timing matter.

  • Strong experience integrating with systems like Salesforce, CPQ, NetSuite, payment platforms, and downstream finance/reporting tooling.

  • Strong proficiency with:

    • JavaScript/TypeScript and object-oriented programming

    • Building and consuming RESTful web services

    • Relational databases, data modeling, and transactional workflows

    • Distributed systems and asynchronous processing

    • Writing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests

    • Logging, telemetry, and production debugging

    • Git and modern CI/CD practices

    • At least one major cloud platform and modern infrastructure tooling

  • A strong product and systems mindset: you can model the commercial domain cleanly, but you also know billing architecture is ultimately customer experience architecture.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Usage-based billing platforms such as Metronome, especially concepts like usage events, billable metrics, products, rate cards, contracts, credits, and programmable invoice workflows.

  • Entitlement and monetization platforms such as Stigg, especially entitlements as a system of record for feature access, limits, credits, and packaging logic.

  • Building systems that support both PLG/self-serve and enterprise sales motions on the same technical foundation.

  • Audit logs, RBAC, webhooks, durable queues, and other patterns that make billing and monetization systems reliable and debuggable in production.

  • AI-assisted development tools

You’ve had success in roles where you:

  • Architected or modernized a billing system that had to support real usage metering, invoice correctness, and flexible commercial models rather than a single static subscription plan.

  • Built systems where raw product activity was transformed into durable billing inputs and surfaced in customer-facing or internal financial workflows.

  • Worked through pricing and packaging changes without repeatedly hardcoding logic into application code.

  • Supported models like prepaid credits, subscriptions with overage, enterprise commitments, or hybrid contracts for different customer segments.

  • Partnered directly with Finance, Accounting, and RevOps to close gaps between what the product did, what the customer bought, and what the company invoiced.

  • Led engineers through ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives where the right answer required balancing correctness, flexibility, speed, and operational simplicity.

  • Communicated complex architectural decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Balanced individual contributor depth with mentoring and unblocking other engineers.

How we support you:

Equity gives every employee a sense of ownership and the opportunity to celebrate our wins together—because your contributions don’t just support our progress; they help drive our collective success.

  • Family Support: We want to support you in life's most important moments, so we offer a paid Parental Leave policy, after six months of employment. Employees also receive access to Kindbody fertility and family-building benefits and dedicated leave specialists who help guide you through the entire process.

  • Growth & Development: Generous annual stipends for both professional and personal development, empowering you to invest in your continued growth. You’ll also have access to a wide range of internal learning opportunities, ensuring you can build new skills, deepen your expertise, and advance your career with confidence.

  • Time Off & Flexibility: We believe that to do your best work, you should get the time you need for rest, rejuvenation and recovery. Drata offers a flexible vacation policy, paid holidays, and other perks to recharge.

Job Summary:

The Staff Software Engineer, Monetization Platform serves as a technical leader with a primary focus on the systems that turn product usage, subscriptions, credits, commitments, and contracts into accurate customer outcomes and clean financial operations.

This person will architect and evolve the core billing domain for Drata: usage event ingestion, billable metrics, pricing and packaging, invoice generation, entitlement enforcement, and the integrations that connect engineering to Accounting, Finance, RevOps, Salesforce, CPQ, and ERP systems like NetSuite.

They should be equally comfortable designing event-driven systems, shaping commercial flexibility with business stakeholders, and building operationally trustworthy software where correctness, audit-ability, and scale matter. Modern billing is no longer just “charge a credit card once a month” — it is a real-time product control plane that must support evolving pricing models without turning the codebase into a fragile mess.

What you’ll do:

 - Partner with Product, Finance, Accounting, RevOps, and Engineering leadership to shape Drata’s long-term billing architecture and commercial flexibility across self-serve and enterprise motions.

 - Design the primitives of a modern billing platform: usage events, billable metrics, products, rate cards, contracts, credits, subscriptions, overages, and invoice workflows.

 - Architect a system that can accurately meter product usage at scale, transform raw events into billable quantities, and support pricing changes without requiring constant product rework.

 - Build and evolve the entitlement layer that separates pricing and packaging from product behavior, so feature access, limits, credits, and plan controls are programmable rather than hardcoded.

 - Work closely with SFDC admins, CPQ owners, and Finance systems stakeholders to ensure quote-to-cash flows are coherent across CRM, product, billing, ERP, and downstream reporting systems.

 - Ensure billing systems are operationally trustworthy: idempotent event handling, strong reconciliation paths, reliable notifications, auditability, and clear observability for engineers and business teams.

 - Review architecture and code for billing-related projects to ensure correctness, scale, security, and maintainability while empowering teams to own implementation details.

 - Troubleshoot the hard problems: invoice discrepancies, usage drift, contract edge cases, entitlement bugs, migration failures, and cross-system data mismatches.

 - Lead cross-team initiatives such as introducing a usage-based billing foundation, rationalizing packaging models, improving billing developer experience, or migrating from brittle homegrown logic to more composable billing and entitlement systems.

 - Mentor engineers across teams on domain modeling, distributed systems tradeoffs, financial correctness, and the realities of building software where product behavior and revenue recognition are tightly coupled.

What you’ll bring:

 - 10+ years of experience as a software engineer, including meaningful time owning business-critical backend systems in production.

 - Deep experience architecting billing, payments, pricing, or quote-to-cash systems for a B2B SaaS company at meaningful scale.

 - Strong experience designing APIs and event-driven systems that ingest, validate, aggregate, and reconcile high-volume operational data.

 - Strong understanding of modern billing models, including usage-based pricing, subscriptions, prepaid credits, commitments, overages, hybrid packaging, and enterprise-specific commercial terms.

 - Experience working directly with Accounting, Finance, RevOps, and GTM systems where data quality, auditability, and timing matter.

 - Strong experience integrating with systems like Salesforce, CPQ, NetSuite, payment platforms, and downstream finance/reporting tooling.

 - Strong proficiency with:
   
   - JavaScript/TypeScript and object-oriented programming
   
   - Building and consuming RESTful web services
   
   - Relational databases, data modeling, and transactional workflows
   
   - Distributed systems and asynchronous processing
   
   - Writing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
   
   - Logging, telemetry, and production debugging
   
   - Git and modern CI/CD practices
   
   - At least one major cloud platform and modern infrastructure tooling

 - A strong product and systems mindset: you can model the commercial domain cleanly, but you also know billing architecture is ultimately customer experience architecture.

Bonus Qualifications

 - Usage-based billing platforms such as Metronome, especially concepts like usage events, billable metrics, products, rate cards, contracts, credits, and programmable invoice workflows.

 - Entitlement and monetization platforms such as Stigg, especially entitlements as a system of record for feature access, limits, credits, and packaging logic.

 - Building systems that support both PLG/self-serve and enterprise sales motions on the same technical foundation.

 - Audit logs, RBAC, webhooks, durable queues, and other patterns that make billing and monetization systems reliable and debuggable in production.

 - AI-assisted development tools

You’ve had success in roles where you:

 - Architected or modernized a billing system that had to support real usage metering, invoice correctness, and flexible commercial models rather than a single static subscription plan.

 - Built systems where raw product activity was transformed into durable billing inputs and surfaced in customer-facing or internal financial workflows.

 - Worked through pricing and packaging changes without repeatedly hardcoding logic into application code.

 - Supported models like prepaid credits, subscriptions with overage, enterprise commitments, or hybrid contracts for different customer segments.

 - Partnered directly with Finance, Accounting, and RevOps to close gaps between what the product did, what the customer bought, and what the company invoiced.

 - Led engineers through ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives where the right answer required balancing correctness, flexibility, speed, and operational simplicity.

 - Communicated complex architectural decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Balanced individual contributor depth with mentoring and unblocking other engineers.

How we support you:
At Drata, our people are our strongest advantage—and we prove it with support that exceeds industry standards. Our total rewards package is designed to power your well-being, accelerate your growth, and keep your work-life balance thriving.

Explore how we invest in your Life at Drata https://drata.com/about/life-at-drata?utm_source=chatgpt.com.

 - Shared Success: We provide stock equity to ensure that as the company grows, you share directly in that success. Equity gives every employee a sense of ownership and the opportunity to celebrate our wins together—because your contributions don’t just support our progress; they help drive our collective success.

 - Health & Wellness: Up to 100% employer-paid premiums for medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their dependents, along with comprehensive wellness benefits and healthcare concierge services designed to support your needs beyond traditional insurance.

 - Financial Well-being: A comprehensive suite of financial benefits, including a 401(k) plan, company-paid life and disability insurance, tax-advantaged spending accounts, and a range of discounted voluntary offerings to help you customize and strengthen your overall financial position.

 - Family Support: We want to support you in life's most important moments, so we offer a paid Parental Leave policy, after six months of employment. Employees also receive access to Kindbody fertility and family-building benefits and dedicated leave specialists who help guide you through the entire process.

 - Growth & Development: Generous annual stipends for both professional and personal development, empowering you to invest in your continued growth. You’ll also have access to a wide range of internal learning opportunities, ensuring you can build new skills, deepen your expertise, and advance your career with confidence.

 - Time Off & Flexibility: We believe that to do your best work, you should get the time you need for rest, rejuvenation and recovery. Drata offers a flexible vacation policy, paid holidays, and other perks to recharge.

Job Summary:

Drata is looking for a Senior Field Marketing Manager to build and execute regional field marketing programs that drive pipeline and revenue impact across our Commercial and Enterprise business.

This role is suited for a results-oriented, savvy field marketer who understands how to build programs that contribute to pipeline growth and measurable business impact. The right candidate brings strong commercial judgment, creative ideas, and the ability to turn strategy into high-impact programs that perform. They know how to build trust across sales, vendors, and partners, tailor experiences for executive and practitioner audiences, and see programs through from idea to follow-up with a clear focus on results.

What you'll do:

  • Own field marketing strategy and execution for a defined AMER region, setting market priorities, regional coverage, and program mix across the U.S.

  • Translate strategy into a regional field marketing plan that supports Commercial and Enterprise growth in priority markets.

  • Develop and manage programs across trade shows, vendor-led executive programs, Drata-led account-focused events, hospitality events with partners, and partner-supported sponsorship opportunities.

  • Design programs for executive and practitioner audiences, adapting format, messaging, and experience by segment, persona, and market.

  • Pilot differentiated event ideas and determine what to refine, repeat, scale, or stop.

  • Build strong relationships across SDRs, AEs, sales leaders, vendors, and partners to drive alignment and program success.

  • Own end-to-end execution, including planning, promotion, logistics, follow-up, and post-program optimization.

  • Measure performance through meetings, engagement, pipeline contribution, and overall program effectiveness.

  • Bring clear recommendations to leadership on where to invest, what to test, and how to improve regional field performance over time.

What you'll bring:

  • 7+ years of experience in B2B field marketing, regional marketing, event marketing, or integrated marketing.

  • A track record of leading in-person and virtual programs that drive pipeline and revenue growth.

  • Experience building programs for executive and practitioner audiences.

  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to earn trust quickly across sales, marketing, vendors, and external partners.

  • Sound judgment on program mix, audience strategy, and where to invest time and budget for the greatest impact.

  • A creative mindset paired with strong execution, follow-through, and measurable results.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where some processes are still being built or refined.

  • This role requires travel across the assigned region based on event cadence and business needs.

  • Excellent communication, organization, and project management skills.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, compliance, or a related technology space is preferred.

  • Willingness to travel 25–35% for Drata and partner events, conferences, team offsites, and other in-person company engagements.

How we support you:
At Drata, our people are our strongest advantage—and we prove it with support that exceeds industry standards. Our total rewards package is designed to power your well-being, accelerate your growth, and keep your work-life balance thriving.

Explore how we invest in your Life at Drata.

  • Shared Success: We provide stock equity to ensure that as the company grows, you share directly in that success. Equity gives every employee a sense of ownership and the opportunity to celebrate our wins together—because your contributions don’t just support our progress; they help drive our collective success.

  • Health & Wellness: Up to 100% employer-paid premiums for medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their dependents, along with comprehensive wellness benefits and healthcare concierge services designed to support your needs beyond traditional insurance.

  • Financial Well-being: A comprehensive suite of financial benefits, including a 401(k) plan, company-paid life and disability insurance, tax-advantaged spending accounts, and a range of discounted voluntary offerings to help you customize and strengthen your overall financial position.

  • Family Support: We want to support you in life's most important moments, so we offer a paid Parental Leave policy, after six months of employment. Employees also receive access to Kindbody fertility and family-building benefits and dedicated leave specialists who help guide you through the entire process.

  • Growth & Development: Generous annual stipends for both professional and personal development, empowering you to invest in your continued growth. You’ll also have access to a wide range of internal learning opportunities, ensuring you can build new skills, deepen your expertise, and advance your career with confidence.

  • Time Off & Flexibility: We believe that to do your best work, you should get the time you need for rest, rejuvenation and recovery. Drata offers a flexible vacation policy, paid holidays, and other perks to recharge.

The expected base salary range for this role is between $135,000 - $207,000 and is listed to provide transparency. Actual base pay will vary based on multiple factors — market location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and overall alignment to the role.

Candidates shouldn't expect automatic placement at any particular point within the range. Offer amounts are determined by the qualifications each candidate brings to the position. Total compensation may also include equity designed to provide meaningful ownership in the company, as well as health and wellbeing benefits.

Job Summary:

As Principal Product Operations, you will define and scale the operating model that enables Product, Design, and Engineering to execute with clarity, rigor, and speed. This is a highly strategic, cross-functional leadership role responsible for shaping how product investments are prioritized, planned, measured, and communicated across the company.

You will partner closely with executive leaders across Product, Design, Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Operations to drive alignment on product strategy, annual and quarterly planning, roadmap governance, portfolio health, experimentation, and business outcomes. You will serve as a force multiplier for the product organization by establishing the systems, cadences, and insights that help teams make better decisions and deliver greater impact at scale.

What you’ll do:

  • Own and evolve the product operating model, including planning frameworks, prioritization practices, governance mechanisms, decision-making cadences, and cross-functional collaboration norms.

  • Lead company-level product planning and roadmap operations, partnering with senior leaders to drive annual planning, quarterly planning, investment tradeoff discussions, commitment tracking, and executive communication.

  • Establish scalable mechanisms to improve visibility, accountability, and execution across the product development lifecycle, from idea intake through launch and post-launch measurement.

  • Drive portfolio-level insight and operational rigor by defining and tracking the health of strategic initiatives, product bets, delivery risks, and outcome attainment.

  • Partner with Product, Design, Engineering, GTM, and Customer teams to improve how customer feedback, market signals, and business priorities inform product decisions.

  • Build and operationalize executive-ready reporting on roadmap progress, product performance, organizational throughput, experimentation results, and key operational metrics.

  • Identify structural inefficiencies and lead high-impact initiatives to improve planning quality, process consistency, speed of execution, and cross-functional alignment.

  • Evaluate, implement, and optimize tooling, systems, and workflows that support product planning, collaboration, experimentation, analytics, and knowledge management.

  • Develop scalable frameworks for experimentation and learning, enabling teams to run effective tests, measure impact, and incorporate findings into product strategy.

  • Create and maintain durable documentation, standards, playbooks, and best practices for product and design operations.

  • Influence leaders at all levels through data-driven recommendations, strong operational judgment, and a clear point of view on how to improve organizational effectiveness.

  • Serve as a thought partner to product and functional leaders on organizational design, process maturity, and operational excellence.

What you’ll bring:

  • 10+ years of experience in product operations, product management, strategy and operations, business operations, or a related discipline, with significant experience in high-growth SaaS and AI-first environments.

  • Demonstrated success operating at principal or director level or equivalent, influencing senior leaders and driving cross-functional change across complex organizations.

  • Deep expertise in product development lifecycles, product management practices, design collaboration models, and engineering partnership.

  • Strong experience leading portfolio planning, roadmap operations, prioritization processes, and executive-level business reviews.

  • Exceptional analytical and systems thinking skills, with the ability to translate data into strategic insights, operational recommendations, and clear decisions.

  • Strong command of product and business analytics ecosystems, including tools such as Segment, Amplitude, Productboard, Linear, Jira, BI platforms, and experimentation frameworks.

  • Experience designing scalable workflows and automations using tools such as Zapier, Retool, or similar platforms.

  • Excellent program leadership skills, including the ability to drive alignment across multiple stakeholders, manage ambiguity, and execute through influence rather than authority.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging for executives, technical partners, and cross-functional audiences.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Design, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.

Personal attributes

  • Strategic: Sees around corners, connects operational details to broader business outcomes, and brings a long-term perspective to organizational scale.

  • Influential: Builds trust quickly, aligns diverse stakeholders, and drives change across functions and levels.

  • Structured: Brings clarity, discipline, and strong judgment to ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

  • Customer-Centric: Keeps customer outcomes at the center of planning, prioritization, and process design.

  • Curious: Uses data, experimentation, and continuous learning to improve systems and outcomes.

  • Collaborative: Operates as a true partner across Product, Design, Engineering, and GTM teams.

How we support you:
At Drata, our people are our strongest advantage—and we prove it with support that exceeds industry standards. Our total rewards package is designed to power your well-being, accelerate your growth, and keep your work-life balance thriving.

Explore how we invest in your Life at Drata.

  • Shared Success: We provide stock equity to ensure that as the company grows, you share directly in that success. Equity gives every employee a sense of ownership and the opportunity to celebrate our wins together—because your contributions don’t just support our progress; they help drive our collective success.

  • Health & Wellness: Up to 100% employer-paid premiums for medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their dependents, along with comprehensive wellness benefits and healthcare concierge services designed to support your needs beyond traditional insurance.

  • Financial Well-being: A comprehensive suite of financial benefits, including a 401(k) plan, company-paid life and disability insurance, tax-advantaged spending accounts, and a range of discounted voluntary offerings to help you customize and strengthen your overall financial position.

  • Family Support: We want to support you in life's most important moments, so we offer a paid Parental Leave policy, after six months of employment. Employees also receive access to Kindbody fertility and family-building benefits and dedicated leave specialists who help guide you through the entire process.

  • Growth & Development: Generous annual stipends for both professional and personal development, empowering you to invest in your continued growth. You’ll also have access to a wide range of internal learning opportunities, ensuring you can build new skills, deepen your expertise, and advance your career with confidence.

  • Time Off & Flexibility: We believe that to do your best work, you should get the time you need for rest, rejuvenation and recovery. Drata offers a flexible vacation policy, paid holidays, and other perks to recharge.

The expected base salary range for this role is between $180,000 - $276,000 and is listed to provide transparency. Actual base pay will vary based on multiple factors — market location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and overall alignment to the role.

 - Excellent program leadership skills, including the ability to drive alignment across multiple stakeholders, manage ambiguity, and execute through influence rather than authority.

 - Influential: Builds trust quickly, aligns diverse stakeholders, and drives change across functions and levels.

Job Summary:

We are looking for a motivated, curious, and solutions-driven Sales Engineer with a passion for helping customers solve complex challenges through technology. In this role, you will support the sales and channel team in engaging prospects and customers, demonstrating technical value, and driving successful outcomes. You will play a key role in both new customer acquisition and expanding relationships with existing customers. Measures of success include contribution to deal progression and overall impact on sales team efficiency and success.

This is a hybrid role with the expectation of working in the London office 1-2 days per week.

What you’ll do:

  • Partner with Account Executives to support prospective customers as they evaluate the Drata platform

  • Support technical proof of concepts and demonstrations, helping to simplify the buyer’s journey

  • Align customer pain points and requirements with proposed solutions

  • Develop and deliver compelling product demonstrations and help win new channel partners.

  • Gather and communicate customer needs to product and engineering teams for future enhancements

  • Conduct competitive research to inform positioning and strategy

  • Assist in building financial business cases for prospective customers

  • Manage technical aspects of RFP/RFI responses and documentation

What you’ll bring:

Curiosity

  • A strong desire to understand customer challenges, industry trends, and evolving technologies

  • Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and solutions

  • Proactive approach to problem-solving, always looking for creative ways to add value

Collaboration

  • Ability to work closely with sales, channel, product, and engineering teams to deliver the best solutions for customers

  • Willingness to share knowledge and contribute to team success

  • A mindset of continuous learning and improvement through feedback and shared experiences

Solutions-Oriented Mindset

  • A proactive approach to identifying challenges and proposing effective solutions

  • Ability to translate technical capabilities into business value for customers

  • Strong analytical thinking to support decision-making and sales strategy

Impactful Communication

  • Ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts in an easy-to-understand manner

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for presentations, customer interactions, and internal collaboration

  • Confidence in delivering demonstrations and engaging with stakeholders at all levels

Preferred Skills & Experience:

  • 2+ years of experience as a Sales / Solutions Engineer preferably in the SaaS space.

  • Working knowledge of common cloud providers across tools including:

    • Infrastructure - AWS, GCP, Azure

    • Identity Management - Okta, Google Workspace, Entra ID

    • Version Control - GitHub, BitBucket, GitLab

  • Experience running trials and POCs and serving as the technical partner of the prospective customer throughout their evaluation.

  • Solid technical background with understanding and/or hands-on experience in integrating cloud systems and API workflows

  • Ability to creatively explain and present complex concepts in an easy to understand manner

  • Experience working in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Excellent presentation and creativity skills

How we support you:
At Drata, our people are our strongest advantage—and we prove it with support that exceeds industry standards. Our total rewards package is designed to power your well-being, accelerate your growth, and keep your work-life balance thriving.

Explore how we invest in your Life at Drata.

  • Shared Success: We provide stock equity to ensure that as the company grows, you share directly in that success. Equity gives every employee a sense of ownership and the opportunity to celebrate our wins together—because your contributions don’t just support our progress; they help drive our collective success.

  • Health & Wellness: Up to 100% employer-paid premiums for medical, employees and their dependents

  • Financial Well-being: To support your retirement planning, our EOR offers a pension plan under which you contribute 5% of your basic earnings, and your employer contributes an additional 4%, helping you build a more secure financial future.

  • Family Support: We want to support you in life's most important moments, so we offer a paid Parental Leave policy, after six months of employment. Employees also receive access to Kindbody fertility and family-building benefits and dedicated leave specialists who help guide you through the entire process.

  • Growth & Development: Generous annual stipends for both professional and personal development, empowering you to invest in your continued growth. You’ll also have access to a wide range of internal learning opportunities, ensuring you can build new skills, deepen your expertise, and advance your career with confidence.

  • Time Off & Flexibility: We believe that to do your best work, you should get the time you need for rest, rejuvenation and recovery. Drata offers a flexible vacation policy, paid holidays, and other perks to recharge.

The expected OTE range for this role is between £126,800 - £156,700 and is listed to provide transparency. Actual base pay will vary based on multiple factors — market location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and overall alignment to the role.

Candidates shouldn't expect automatic placement at any particular point within the range. Offer amounts are determined by the qualifications each candidate brings to the position. Total compensation may also include equity designed to provide meaningful ownership in the company, as well as health and wellbeing benefits.

Job Summary:

As Senior Marketing Operations Manager, you will lead the strategy, execution, and optimization of our marketing technology ecosystem. You will architect, implement, and manage the systems and integrations that power our go-to-market (GTM) engine, with a sharp focus on scalability, data integrity, automation, and lead orchestration.

 

This role is pivotal in ensuring that marketing, sales, customer success, business development and product teams are aligned and empowered to execute with speed and precision. You’re a Driver, you don’t just wait for projects and problems to come to you, but you identify them and execute without hesitation.

 

This role will report to the Director, Marketing Operations, a critical part of our connected GTM Operations team. You’ll bring a track record of proven success, preferably in a high-growth, fast-paced startup environment.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the marketing technology stack (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce integration, LeanData, Qualified, 6sense, attribution tooling, etc) — driving roadmap, implementation, integration, and performance.

  • Evaluate, recommend, and deploy new tools to enhance marketing execution and measurement.

  • Architect a scalable infrastructure that supports pipeline acceleration, attribution, scoring, and personalized engagement.

  • Translate lead management and routing requirements into system logic.

  • Own end-to-end implementation of lead assignment rules, SLAs, escalation flows, and scoring models.

  • Partner with Sales Ops and Marketing Ops to continuously optimize routing for speed, accuracy, and fairness.

  • Ensure data quality, enrichment, normalization, and compliance across platforms.

  • Monitor data pipelines and troubleshoot discrepancies across systems.

  • Establish governance frameworks for platform changes, including documentation, QA, and release management.

  • Serve as the technical lead for marketing in cross-functional projects, including GTM launches, sales handoff optimization, and analytics integration.

  • Identify automation opportunities to increase operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.

  • Leverage AI and machine learning capabilities in tools to enhance targeting, scoring, and predictive analytics.

  • Monitor and report on system health, performance metrics, and process efficiency.

What you’ll bring:

  • 7+ years of experience with HubSpot, SFDC, 6sense, LeanData, Clay, Qualified, and other prospecting tools

  • Deep expertise with marketing automation, CRM systems, and data integration tools (Marketo, Salesforce, LeanData, Segment, Workato, or similar).

  • Strong understanding of lead lifecycle, funnel stages, routing logic, and attribution models.

  • Experience with API integrations, custom workflows, and marketing data schemas.

  • Strong organizational and project management skills.

  • An unmatched attention to detail, taking pride in everything you do and understanding that the little things matter

  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a results-driven environment

How we support you:
At Drata, our people are our strongest advantage—and we prove it with support that exceeds industry standards. Our total rewards package is designed to power your well-being, accelerate your growth, and keep your work-life balance thriving.

Explore how we invest in your Life at Drata.

  • Shared Success: We provide stock equity to ensure that as the company grows, you share directly in that success. Equity gives every employee a sense of ownership and the opportunity to celebrate our wins together—because your contributions don’t just support our progress; they help drive our collective success.

  • Health & Wellness: Up to 100% employer-paid premiums for medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their dependents, along with comprehensive wellness benefits and healthcare concierge services designed to support your needs beyond traditional insurance.

  • Financial Well-being: A comprehensive suite of financial benefits, including a 401(k) plan, company-paid life and disability insurance, tax-advantaged spending accounts, and a range of discounted voluntary offerings to help you customize and strengthen your overall financial position.

  • Family Support: We want to support you in life's most important moments, so we offer a paid Parental Leave policy, after six months of employment. Employees also receive access to Kindbody fertility and family-building benefits and dedicated leave specialists who help guide you through the entire process.

  • Growth & Development: Generous annual stipends for both professional and personal development, empowering you to invest in your continued growth. You’ll also have access to a wide range of internal learning opportunities, ensuring you can build new skills, deepen your expertise, and advance your career with confidence.

  • Time Off & Flexibility: We believe that to do your best work, you should get the time you need for rest, rejuvenation and recovery. Drata offers a flexible vacation policy, paid holidays, and other perks to recharge.

The expected base salary range for this role is between $135,000 - $207,000 and is listed to provide transparency. Actual base pay will vary based on multiple factors — market location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and overall alignment to the role.

Candidates shouldn't expect automatic placement at any particular point within the range. Offer amounts are determined by the qualifications each candidate brings to the position. Total compensation may also include equity designed to provide meaningful ownership in the company, as well as health and wellbeing benefits.

Job Summary:

Drata is looking for a Senior Manager, Commercial Account Management to lead and develop a high-performing team serving primarily mid-market customers with moderate complexity, multiple stakeholders, and meaningful expansion potential. This people-leadership role is accountable for team performance across retention, renewals, expansion, adoption, value realization, customer health, and forecast accuracy, while setting clear standards for customer engagement, commercial execution, and operational discipline. The Senior Manager will coach and develop the team, hire and retain strong talent, provide leadership with forward-looking insight, and build the systems, playbooks, and cross-functional partnerships that make strong customer and recurring-revenue outcomes repeatable. This role does not carry an individual book of business and requires strong executive presence, analytical judgment, GRC or regulated-technology experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively across the organization.

What you’ll do:

Lead and develop the team

  • Hire, coach, and develop Commercial Account Managers, setting clear expectations, performance standards, and career paths.

  • Build a high-performing, collaborative team culture through regular coaching, feedback, account reviews, and fair performance management.

  • Establish consistent standards for account planning, customer engagement, CRM hygiene, forecasting, and execution.

Job Summary:

As a Solutions Architect supporting APAC at Drata, you’ll be a customer-facing technical partner helping enterprise customers implement, adopt, and expand their use of Drata’s security and compliance automation platform. You’ll own the technical customer experience from kickoff through ongoing adoption—serving as implementation lead, platform expert, trainer, and trusted advisor.

You’ll work closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Engineering to solve complex customer needs, improve technical enablement, and represent the needs of APAC customers. This role requires availability to start at 8:00 a.m. local time to support collaboration with North American teams.

What you’ll do:

  • Own a portfolio of APAC enterprise customers as their primary technical point of contact.

  • Lead end-to-end implementations, including project plans, milestones, risk management, stakeholder coordination, configuration, testing, and launch readiness.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and translate business, security, and compliance requirements into scalable solutions.

  • Monitor customer health, usage, renewal risk, and expansion opportunities; partner with Customer Success to address risks proactively.

  • Configure and customize Drata, integrate customer systems, support data migrations, and troubleshoot complex technical issues.

  • Advise customers on integrations, APIs, cloud infrastructure, identity and access, development workflows, security tools, HR systems, and AI-enabled compliance workflows.

  • Deliver training, workshops, QBR technical insights, documentation, and self-service guidance that increase customer adoption and independence.

  • Reduce engineering escalations by diagnosing issues, documenting platform behavior, and providing clear technical remediations.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on UAT, bug reports, feature requests, customer use cases, and regional requirements.

  • Share APAC customer trends and best practices across Customer Success and the broader company through enablement and technical documentation.

What you'll bring:

  • 8+ years of post-sales experience in a Solutions Architect, Technical Account Manager, Implementation Manager, Customer Success Engineer, or similar role in B2B SaaS.

  • Demonstrated success leading complex, end-to-end enterprise implementations.

  • Customer-facing experience with excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting, training, and debugging with both technical and executive audiences.

  • 5+ years in security, compliance, GRC, or a related field is preferred.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered tools or platforms, ideally applied to compliance or GRC workflows.

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure; REST APIs and JSON; and scripting or development with technologies such as JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Python, Bash, Shell, or Unix.

  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, QA, and Security teams.

  • Based in, or able to work hours aligned with, the APAC region. English fluency is required; additional regional languages are a plus.

  • Familiarity with APAC regulatory, data residency, or market requirements is a plus.

How we support you:
At Drata, our people are our strongest advantage—and we prove it with support that exceeds industry standards. Our total rewards package is designed to power your well-being, accelerate your growth, and keep your work-life balance thriving.

Explore how we invest in your Life at Drata.

  • Shared Success: We provide stock equity to ensure that as the company grows, you share directly in that success. Equity gives every employee a sense of ownership and the opportunity to celebrate our wins together—because your contributions don’t just support our progress; they help drive our collective success.

  • Health & Wellness: Up to 100% employer-paid premiums for medical, employees and their dependents

  • Financial Well-being: To support your retirement planning, our EOR offers a pension plan under which you contribute 5% of your basic earnings, and your employer contributes an additional 4%, helping you build a more secure financial future.

  • Family Support: We want to support you in life's most important moments, so we offer a paid Parental Leave policy, after six months of employment. Employees also receive access to Kindbody fertility and family-building benefits and dedicated leave specialists who help guide you through the entire process.

  • Growth & Development: Generous annual stipends for both professional and personal development, empowering you to invest in your continued growth. You’ll also have access to a wide range of internal learning opportunities, ensuring you can build new skills, deepen your expertise, and advance your career with confidence.

  • Time Off & Flexibility: We believe that to do your best work, you should get the time you need for rest, rejuvenation and recovery. Drata offers a flexible vacation policy, paid holidays, and other perks to recharge.

The expected OTE range for this role is between AUD $270,300 - AUD $318,000 and is listed to provide transparency. Actual base pay will vary based on multiple factors — market location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and overall alignment to the role.

Candidates shouldn't expect automatic placement at any particular point within the range. Offer amounts are determined by the qualifications each candidate brings to the position. Job Summary:

Drata is building a world-class customer education function — and we're looking for the person who will own it.

As Learning & Development Specialist, you'll be the architect of how Drata customers learn: designing the programs, building the certifications, and creating the infrastructure that helps thousands of security and compliance practitioners get value from Drata faster and more independently. A critical part of this role is understanding that Enterprise and SMB customers don't learn the same way — you'll design programs that meet each segment where they are, with the right depth, format, and pacing for their needs.

You'll sit within the Digital CS team — alongside Community, in-app guidance, automated playbooks, and 1:M events — and you'll be the expert who defines what great customer education looks like at Drata across every customer segment.

This is a senior IC role. You won't manage people on day one, but you'll lead the discipline. You'll set the strategy, own the roadmap, and be the voice of customer education across the company. As the function matures, there's a clear path to building a team under you.

You'll report directly to the Sr. Director of Digital CS, who leads all of Drata's Digital CS programs.

What you'll do:

Build and mature the Drata Academy program

  • Own the Drata Academy roadmap — course library strategy, learning path design, and the overall curriculum architecture across Drata's product suite (GRC, Trust Center, AIQA, TPRM)

  • Design distinct learning experiences for Enterprise and SMB customers — Enterprise teams need depth, role-based paths, and content that scales across large orgs; SMB customers need fast time-to-value, opinionated guidance, and lean formats that fit a lean team

  • Take Academy from a newly launched platform to a mature, comprehensive education program with measurable customer outcomes

  • Define what 'good' looks like for customer education at Drata — frameworks, standards, and content quality bar

  • Build a scalable content production process using AI-assisted authoring tools (Claude Design, Arcade, and similar) to create high-quality courses without engineering dependency

  • Partner with Product to stay ahead of feature releases and ensure education content ships in sync with the product

Launch and own the Drata Admin Certification program

  • Design and build Drata's first customer certification program — the Drata Admin Certification — from curriculum design through to assessment, badging, and renewal

  • Define the certification framework: competency model, exam structure, passing criteria, and credential lifecycle

  • Partner with the Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing teams to position the Drata Admin Certification as a meaningful credential in the GRC and security compliance market

  • Build the ecosystem around certification: study guides, prep courses, practice assessments, and community-based peer learning

Drive education impact with AI and data

  • Use AI tools meaningfully throughout the content lifecycle — not just for drafting, but for personalization, adaptive learning paths, and content gap identification at scale

  • Define and own education KPIs: course completion rates, certification pass rates, time-to-proficiency, and correlation between education engagement and GRR/NRR

  • Partner with the Digital CS team's data infrastructure (Snowflake, Hook.co) to connect Academy engagement to customer health scores and retention outcomes

  • Report education program performance in the quarterly Digital CS QBR and continuously improve based on what the data shows

Integrate education across the Digital CS ecosystem

  • Connect Academy to the broader Digital CS motion — surface course recommendations in automated playbooks, in-app tooltips, and community content

  • Partner with the Community Manager to make community a learning accelerator: expert-led sessions, peer knowledge sharing, and certification prep cohorts

  • Collaborate with the 1:M events program to create learning continuity between live sessions and self-paced Academy content

  • Ensure education content reinforces the in-app guidance experience — tooltips, Arcade videos, and Academy courses telling a consistent story

What you'll bring:

  • 5–8 years of experience in customer education, learning & development, or instructional design at a B2B SaaS company

  • Proven track record building or maturing a customer education program — ideally across companies at different stages (early-stage build to scaled program)

  • Experience designing L&D programs for both Enterprise and SMB customers — you understand that a Fortune 500 security team and a 20-person startup have fundamentally different learning needs, timelines, and success metrics, and you've built programs that reflect that

  • Certification program experience — you've designed, launched, or owned a professional certification or credentialing program end-to-end

  • Hands-on LMS expertise — deep experience with Skilljar, Gainsight Academy, Docebo, Thought Industries, or similar platforms

  • AI fluency with real business impact — you've used AI tools to meaningfully accelerate content creation, improve learning outcomes, or scale a program; you can speak to the results

  • Strong instructional design instincts — you understand adult learning principles, can design for different modalities (video, interactive, assessment), and know what makes content actually stick

  • Data-driven — you track completion rates, certification outcomes, and business impact, and you use that data to make decisions

  • Cross-functional collaborator — comfortable working with Product, CS, Marketing, and Support to align education to the customer journey

Job Summary:

You'll sit within the Digital CS team — alongside Community, in-app guidance, automated playbooks, and 1:M events — and you'll be the expert who defines what great customer education looks like at Drata across every customer segment.

This is a senior IC role. You won't manage people on day one, but you'll lead the discipline. You'll set the strategy, own the roadmap, and be the voice of customer education across the company. As the function matures, there's a clear path to building a team under you.

You'll report directly to the Sr. Director of Digital CS, who leads all of Drata's Digital CS programs.

 - Take Academy from a newly launched platform to a mature, comprehensive education program with measurable customer outcomes

 - Define what 'good' looks like for customer education at Drata — frameworks, standards, and content quality bar

 - Build a scalable content production process using AI-assisted authoring tools (Claude Design, Arcade, and similar) to create high-quality courses without engineering dependency

 - Partner with Product to stay ahead of feature releases and ensure education content ships in sync with the product

Launch and own the Drata Admin Certification program

 - Design and build Drata's first customer certification program — the Drata Admin Certification — from curriculum design through to assessment, badging, and renewal

 - Define the certification framework: competency model, exam structure, passing criteria, and credential lifecycle

 - Partner with the Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing teams to position the Drata Admin Certification as a meaningful credential in the GRC and security compliance market

 - Build the ecosystem around certification: study guides, prep courses, practice assessments, and community-based peer learning

Drive education impact with AI and data

 - Use AI tools meaningfully throughout the content lifecycle — not just for drafting, but for personalization, adaptive learning paths, and content gap identification at scale

 - Define and own education KPIs: course completion rates, certification pass rates, time-to-proficiency, and correlation between education engagement and GRR/NRR

 - Partner with the Digital CS team's data infrastructure (Snowflake, Hook.co) to connect Academy engagement to customer health scores and retention outcomes

 - Report education program performance in the quarterly Digital CS QBR and continuously improve based on what the data shows

 - Connect Academy to the broader Digital CS motion — surface course recommendations in automated playbooks, in-app tooltips, and community content

 - Partner with the Community Manager to make community a learning accelerator: expert-led sessions, peer knowledge sharing, and certification prep cohorts

 - Collaborate with the 1:M events program to create learning continuity between live sessions and self-paced Academy content

 - Ensure education content reinforces the in-app guidance experience — tooltips, Arcade videos, and Academy courses telling a consistent story

 - Proven track record building or maturing a customer education program — ideally across companies at different stages (early-stage build to scaled program)

 - Experience designing L&D programs for both Enterprise and SMB customers — you understand that a Fortune 500 security team and a 20-person startup have fundamentally different learning needs, timelines, and success metrics, and you've built programs that reflect that

Job Summary:

As a Partner Program Manager at Drata, you own the service delivery side of Drata’s partner ecosystem — the consulting firms, MSPs, and vCISOs who help our customers achieve and sustain audit-ready security and compliance postures. This role sits within the Professional Services function of the Customer Success organization at Drata and partners closely with our Channel Sales program manager (who owns sales-side partner enablement) so that the sales and delivery experiences feel like one cohesive program to our partners. You’ll be the connective tissue between our service partners and our internal Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams — owning the relationships, the services-side enablement content, and the delivery quality bar that together determine the consistency of customer outcomes delivered through our partner ecosystem.

We are hiring for this role in either Central or Eastern time to help to support those regions.

What you’ll do:

  • Own day-to-day relationships with a portfolio of service delivery partners (consultancies, MSPs, vCISO firms), serving as their primary point of contact across program participation, escalations, joint pipeline, and growth planning.

  • Run partner business reviews (QBRs/MBRs) with senior stakeholders at partner firms; align on joint goals, delivery capacity, and quarterly commitments.

  • Support light partner recruitment, working off internally-sourced leads (from Sales, CS, and PS colleagues who are already in front of services firms worth partnering with) rather than open-market sourcing — shepherding promising firms through onboarding and into the program.

  • Partner with our Partner Certification team to ensure services-focused learning content is built and maintained alongside the existing sales certification tracks. Drata has strong sales-side enablement today; this role fills the current gap where there is no dedicated owner for the services delivery learning path.

  • Own the broader services-side partner enablement experience — onboarding, ongoing training, instructor-led workshops, and rollouts of new product features and frameworks tailored to a delivery audience.

  • Define and monitor partner delivery quality metrics (implementation CSAT, time-to-audit, control coverage at audit, escalation rates) and drive remediation programs where delivery falls short of Drata’s standard.

  • Build feedback loops with Drata’s Professional Services and Customer Success teams to surface delivery issues early and feed lessons back into partner enablement and program design.

  • Coordinate closely with our Channel Sales program manager so that the sales-side and services-side partner experiences land as one program — shared rhythms, consistent messaging, and clean handoffs at every stage of the partner lifecycle.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in partner programs, channel/alliances, partner enablement, or partner operations at a B2B SaaS company — or equivalent experience leading services delivery or partner engagement at a consulting or audit firm working closely with SaaS platforms.

  • Demonstrated experience designing or operating partner enablement, certification, or accreditation programs at scale.

  • Strong program management skills — able to run multiple concurrent workstreams and partner cohorts without dropping balls.

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Marketing, and Product — and able to translate partner feedback into clear, actionable asks for each team.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to internal leadership and to senior stakeholders at partner firms.

  • Proven self-starter able to take ambiguous problems, define structure, and ship — challenging the status quo where current processes don’t scale.

  • A team-player mindset and a desire to build something from the ground up inside a rapidly growing organization.

  • Nice to have: Familiarity with the GRC, security, or compliance space and the current players in it — competitors, the major audit firms, and the consultancies most active in this market. You don’t need to be a compliance practitioner to do this job, but knowing the landscape will accelerate your ramp.

  • Nice to have: Direct experience working at — or building a partner program for — a GRC, security, or compliance vendor.

  • Nice to have: Familiarity with a partner relationship management (PRM) platform (Allbound, Impartner, PartnerStack, etc.) and with Salesforce-based partner workflows.

  • Nice to have: Light technical fluency — enough comfort with Drata’s platform capabilities, API surface, and integration points to credibly engage implementation partners on technical scoping conversations.

  • Nice to have: Industry certifications relevant to the GRC space (CISA, CISSP, CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor / Lead Implementer) or to partner programs (e.g., ASAP CA-AM).

Job Summary:

As a Partner Program Manager at Drata, you own the service delivery side of Drata’s partner ecosystem — the consulting firms, MSPs, and vCISOs who help our customers achieve and sustain audit-ready security and compliance postures. This role sits within the Professional Services function of the Customer Success organization at Drata and partners closely with our Channel Sales program manager (who owns sales-side partner enablement) so that the sales and delivery experiences feel like one cohesive program to our partners. You’ll be the connective tissue between our service partners and our internal Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams — owning the relationships, the services-side enablement content, and the delivery quality bar that together determine the consistency of customer outcomes delivered through our partner ecosystem.

We are hiring for this role in either Central or Eastern time to help to support those regions.

What you’ll do:

 - Own day-to-day relationships with a portfolio of service delivery partners (consultancies, MSPs, vCISO firms), serving as their primary point of contact across program participation, escalations, joint pipeline, and growth planning.

 - Run partner business reviews (QBRs/MBRs) with senior stakeholders at partner firms; align on joint goals, delivery capacity, and quarterly commitments.

 - Support light partner recruitment, working off internally-sourced leads (from Sales, CS, and PS colleagues who are already in front of services firms worth partnering with) rather than open-market sourcing — shepherding promising firms through onboarding and into the program.

 - Partner with our Partner Certification team to ensure services-focused learning content is built and maintained alongside the existing sales certification tracks. Drata has strong sales-side enablement today; this role fills the current gap where there is no dedicated owner for the services delivery learning path.

 - Own the broader services-side partner enablement experience — onboarding, ongoing training, instructor-led workshops, and rollouts of new product features and frameworks tailored to a delivery audience.

 - Define and monitor partner delivery quality metrics (implementation CSAT, time-to-audit, control coverage at audit, escalation rates) and drive remediation programs where delivery falls short of Drata’s standard.

 - Build feedback loops with Drata’s Professional Services and Customer Success teams to surface delivery issues early and feed lessons back into partner enablement and program design.

 - Coordinate closely with our Channel Sales program manager so that the sales-side and services-side partner experiences land as one program — shared rhythms, consistent messaging, and clean handoffs at every stage of the partner lifecycle.

What you’ll bring:

 - 5+ years of experience in partner programs, channel/alliances, partner enablement, or partner operations at a B2B SaaS company — or equivalent experience leading services delivery or partner engagement at a consulting or audit firm working closely with SaaS platforms.

 - Demonstrated experience designing or operating partner enablement, certification, or accreditation programs at scale.

 - Strong program management skills — able to run multiple concurrent workstreams and partner cohorts without dropping balls.

 - Comfort working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Marketing, and Product — and able to translate partner feedback into clear, actionable asks for each team.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to internal leadership and to senior stakeholders at partner firms.

 - Proven self-starter able to take ambiguous problems, define structure, and ship — challenging the status quo where current processes don’t scale.

 - A team-player mindset and a desire to build something from the ground up inside a rapidly growing organization.

 - Nice to have: Familiarity with the GRC, security, or compliance space and the current players in it — competitors, the major audit firms, and the consultancies most active in this market. You don’t need to be a compliance practitioner to do this job, but knowing the landscape will accelerate your ramp.

 - Nice to have: Direct experience working at — or building a partner program for — a GRC, security, or compliance vendor.

 - Nice to have: Familiarity with a partner relationship management (PRM) platform (Allbound, Impartner, PartnerStack, etc.) and with Salesforce-based partner workflows.

 - Nice to have: Light technical fluency — enough comfort with Drata’s platform capabilities, API surface, and integration points to credibly engage implementation partners on technical scoping conversations.

 - Nice to have: Industry certifications relevant to the GRC space (CISA, CISSP, CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor / Lead Implementer) or to partner programs (e.g., ASAP CA-AM).

How we support you:
At Drata, our people are our strongest advantage—and we prove it with support that exceeds industry standards. Our total rewards package is designed to power your well-being, accelerate your growth, and keep your work-life balance thriving.

Explore how we invest in your Life at Drata https://drata.com/about/life-at-drata?utm_source=chatgpt.com.

 - Shared Success: We provide stock equity to ensure that as the company grows, you share directly in that success. Equity gives every employee a sense of ownership and the opportunity to celebrate our wins together—because your contributions don’t just support our progress; they help drive our collective success.

 - Health & Wellness: Up to 100% employer-paid premiums for medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their dependents, along with comprehensive wellness benefits and healthcare concierge services designed to support your needs beyond traditional insurance.

 - Financial Well-being: A comprehensive suite of financial benefits, including a 401(k) plan, company-paid life and disability insurance, tax-advantaged spending accounts, and a range of discounted voluntary offerings to help you customize and strengthen your overall financial position.

 - Family Support: We want to support you in life's most important moments, so we offer a paid Parental Leave policy, after six months of employment. Employees also receive access to Kindbody fertility and family-building benefits and dedicated leave specialists who help guide you through the entire process.

 - Growth & Development: Generous annual stipends for both professional and personal development, empowering you to invest in your continued growth. You’ll also have access to a wide range of internal learning opportunities, ensuring you can build new skills, deepen your expertise, and advance your career with confidence.

 - Time Off & Flexibility: We believe that to do your best work, you should get the time you need for rest, rejuvenation and recovery. Drata offers a flexible vacation policy, paid holidays, and other perks to recharge.

The expected OTE range for this role is between $125,000 - $191,000 and is listed to provide transparency. Actual base pay will vary based on multiple factors — market location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and overall alignment to the role. 

Candidates shouldn't expect automatic placement at any particular point within the range. Offer amounts are determined by the qualifications each candidate brings to the position. Total compensation may also include equity designed to provide meaningful ownership in the company, as well as health and wellbeing benefits.

Job Summary:

We are looking for a passionate sales professional with 7+ years of experience in a customer facing role selling SaaS or consulting with an ability to focus on the Enterprise space - not necessarily in the security and compliance space. Exceptional candidates are hungry to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, and have a proven track record of success in their past roles and experiences!

What you’ll do:

  • Develop and execute strategies for driving partnerships and revenue

  • Build and manage your pipeline of prospects; become an expert on a region and understanding the complexities of that specific market

  • Consult senior executives to discover their needs and educate them through an accelerated buying process

  • Identify opportunities to improve our product offering based on deep understanding of the needs of our customers

What you’ll bring:

  • 7+ years of experience in a customer-facing B2B SaaS Sales role, with at least 2 years in a closing new business capacity

  • Professionally Proficient/Fluent in English

  • Ability to focus on bringing in Enterprise accounts with 1K+ full time employees

  • Preferred background in the start-up space

  • Self-starter who brings ideas to life and takes pride in results

  • Resourceful, finding ways to get things done regardless of the obstacles

  • Organized and detail-oriented with an ability to handle a variety of different projects

  • A talented communicator and a “people person” who enjoys working with others. You are thoughtful about the ways you communicate and the impact that may have on a customer.
